label: US-42USC2000e-TitleVII-1964 42 U.S.C. 2000e-13

obligations.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of sections 111 and 1114 of title 18, whoever in violation of the provisions of section 1114 of such title kills a person while engaged in or on account of the performance of his official functions under this Act shall be punished by imprisonment for any term of years or for life.
